brand_identity.name: ClearMarket
brand_identity.mission: Empower Indian retail investors with jargon-free, actionable stock insights.
brand_identity.visual_style: Modern Fintech (Groww-inspired but distinct). Clean, white-space heavy, rounded corners, mobile-first.

usage_rules: Use Plus Jakarta Sans for all Headings (h1-h3) and Navigation links.
Use Inter for all body text, data tables, and inputs.
Use JetBrains Mono for stock tickers (e.g., RELIANCE, TCS) and numeric data in tables.
Body text should have relaxed leading (1.6) for readability.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 shadow-lg shadow-emerald-600/20 transition-all duration-300 rounded-full px-8 py-3 font-medium
buttons.secondary: bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-800 dark:text-slate-100 rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium
buttons.outline: border-2 border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:border-emerald-600 hover:text-emerald-600 bg-transparent rounded-full px-6 py-2 font-medium transition-colors

cards.base: bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-300

inputs.style: h-12 rounded-lg border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500 focus:border-transparent bg-slate-50 dark:bg-slate-950

watermark.style: absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center opacity-[0.03] pointer-events-none select-none z-0

verdict_badge.buy: bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-sm font-bold uppercase tracking-wide

hero_main.alt: Happy Indian investor succeeding in market
hero_main.usage: Landing Page Hero Section - Right side

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text-to-background contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.
accessibility.focus_states: Visible focus rings on all interactive elements (ring-2 ring-emerald-500).

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Implement a Dark/Light mode toggle using Tailwind's 'class' strategy. Default to Light mode.
3. LAYOUT: Use the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the Dashboard. Key metrics (Portfolio Value) must be prominent.
4. COMPONENTS: Use Shadcn UI for complex interactions (Dialogs, Selects, Tabs). Customize them to match the 'Rounded & Clean' aesthetic.
5. CHARTS: Use 'Recharts' for stock price history. Style them minimally (remove grid lines if possible, use gradients).
6. WATERMARK: Ensure every PDF report or Analysis View has the 'ClearMarket' watermark in the background.
7. MOBILE: Ensure the bottom navigation bar is present on mobile for quick access to Dashboard/Portfolio/Search.
8. DATA: Mock all stock data realistically. Do not use 'Lorem Ipsum' for financial data. Use real ticker names (RELIANCE, HDFCBANK, TATAMOTORS).
9. AUTH: Create a clean, split-screen layout for Login/Signup. Left side: Form. Right side: Testimonial/Image.
10. TESTING: Add 'data-testid' to all buttons, inputs, and major containers.

universal_guidelines.design_philosophy: Clarity over Clutter. If a pixel doesn't serve a purpose, remove it.
anti_patterns: Do not use complex gradients for backgrounds (keep it subtle).
Do not clutter the mobile view with too many columns.
code_style: Use Tailwind utility classes for 99% of styling.
